issue_title: feaLib: handling of duplicate lookup references
hints_text:
The extra lookup is probably harmless since it is the same feature so each lookup will be applied only once, at least HarfBuzz seems to apply each lookup only once:
```
$ hb-shape -V c.otf ab --features=+test
trace: start table GSUB	buffer: [a=0|b=1]
trace: start lookup 0 feature 'test'	buffer: [a=0|b=1]
trace: replacing glyph at 0 (single substitution)	buffer: [a=0|b=1]
trace: replaced glyph at 0 (single substitution)	buffer: [A=0|b=1]
trace: end lookup 0 feature 'test'	buffer: [A=0|b=1]
trace: start lookup 1 feature 'test'	buffer: [A=0|b=1]
trace: replacing glyph at 1 (single substitution)	buffer: [A=0|b=1]
trace: replaced glyph at 1 (single substitution)	buffer: [A=0|B=1]
trace: end lookup 1 feature 'test'	buffer: [A=0|B=1]
trace: end table GSUB	buffer: [A=0|B=1]
trace: start fallback mark	buffer: [A=0+525|B=1+525]
trace: end fallback mark	buffer: [A=0+525|B=1+525]
[A=0+525|B=1+525]
```
Sorry, I should've updated this issue: on closer look, the opentype layout algorithm (as [summarized in the FEA spec](https://github.com/adobe-type-tools/afdko/blob/develop/docs/OpenTypeFeatureFileSpecification.md#7a-an-opentype-layout-engines-layout-algorithm)) says,

> 3. Assemble all lookups in these features, in LookupList order, removing any duplicates. (All features and thus all lookups needn't be applied to every glyph in the run.)

So I agree that this isn't a correctness issue, just a bit of extra work for the shaper.
